recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in mid-century attire sitting cross-legged in a garden, featuring heavy top-left justified typography against a dense green foliage background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally but offset by an empty chair to his left
Dense, dark green foliage acting as a textured backdrop for light-colored text
Contrast between the subject's structured plaid blazer and the organic leaf patterns
Typographic block anchored to the top-left corner, overlapping the background
coreInvariants: Subject in a seated, cross-legged pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, full body, occupying approximately 60% of vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright text block in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title in the top left, moves down the text list, then follows the subject's gaze and pose toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The ground area at the bottom and the dense foliage to the right of the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale yellow (typography and chairs)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue and grey (subject's trousers and blazer)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a matte, vintage film finish; high value contrast between text and background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights and colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century geometric aesthetic and tight spacing.
Provides a similar sturdy, functional feel for the list text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1960s-style photograph of a man in a grey plaid blazer and blue trousers sitting cross-legged on a light-colored metal garden chair. Next to him is an identical empty chair. The background is a dense, dark green hedge. The ground is light dirt. The lighting is soft, overcast daylight with a vintage film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a block of left-aligned text in the top-left corner. Use a bold geometric sans-serif for the main title in off-white, and a smaller medium-weight version in pale yellow for a list of items below it. Ensure tight line spacing.

verificationChecks: Background foliage is dense and fills the frame
Subject is wearing a plaid pattern
Color palette is muted and vintage

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of yellow for secondary text
Number of items in the text list
mustRedesign: Original artist name and specific song titles
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Is the text legible against the leaves?
Does the subject's pose feel relaxed and formal?
Is the grain consistent across the image?
Are the chairs period-accurate (metal folding style)?
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Dense Foliage Backdrop + Top-Left Geometric Sans Typography
